strategies.name: liquidity_grab_reversal
strategies.entry_summary: Enter at the price level of the candle that made the liquidity grab after price briefly breaks support or resistance and reverses. For a bullish setup, use a sell-side liquidity grab below support and enter long at the top of the grab candle; for a bearish setup, use a buy-side liquidity grab above/
strategies.exit_summary: Place the stop loss just beyond the liquidity-grab extreme (below the grab for longs, above it for shorts) and take profit at the nearest/recent swing high for longs or recent swing low for shorts.

variants.timeframe_note: Works on all timeframes; examples include daily and 15-minute
